title: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
why_read: A configurable framework for building your own 'trending topics' news site by swapping in your own sources and curation rules.
analysis: This GitHub project is a TypeScript framework for automatically finding trending items and generating a daily digest site, with sources and selection criteria meant to be customized by the user. It's essentially a generic, self-hostable version of a 'hot topics aggregator,' which could be useful as a template for building internal or niche news digests. The high star count suggests real community interest, likely from developers wanting a quick way to spin up their own curated content site rather than from deep technical novelty.
